Footprint Real Estate is pleased to offer this spacious upgraded 3-bedroom apartment located in the prestigious Dubai Marina. With a generous built-up area of 4,565 sqft, this well-designed home offers comfortable living spaces, a private balcony, and an exceptional lifestyle in one of Dubai's most sought-after waterfront communities.

About Dubai Marina:
Dubai Marina is one of Dubai's most vibrant waterfront destinations, offering a premium lifestyle surrounded by luxury residences, world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment. Residents enjoy easy access to Marina Walk, beautiful beaches, yacht clubs, and major road networks including Sheikh Zayed Road. The community is well connected by Dubai Metro and Tram, making it an ideal location for families and professionals seeking convenience, luxury, and a dynamic urban lifestyle.
